messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to inform you that Lloyds Bank carries out client details verification procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'The account is under security measure because we noticed in the last 24 Hours that your Access is opened with different computer and location, to protect your Account you need to confirm it by the secured link below', 'Some of your important messages were queued on our mail server.', 'To address this, Standard Bank has released a 128-bit SSL update for the online banking page that eliminates this bug.', 'Please contact your financial institution to obtain the necessary update=BS of the Direct Deposit software.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'We would like to inform you that we have released a new version of Bank of America Customer Form.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Please be prepared for all systems to be offline for maintenance tomorrow night.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
